title: 第二十六章 新的客人
content_zh:
第二十六章 新的客人-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

上一章

存书签

下一章

不知为何，看着前面的建筑，他们的心中莫名生出了一股感觉，那就是，只要过去，他们就一定能够活下去。

这个念头出现的瞬间，就连他们自己都觉得荒谬，毕竟如此怪异的建筑出现，他们本应感觉到危机才对，要不然，为什么那些人宁愿自己抱团，攻占其他小区，也不愿意来这里，还不是因为怕这里是圈套，他们过来便是羊入虎口。

此时的爻雪还不知道，这么多天以来自己的客人之所以这么少是因为这个原因，她还在想，等到觉醒异能的客人越来越多之后，其他人知道之后，她就不愁客源了，到时候房间估计也会供不应求。

除了外面的那些资源之外，秘境也算是一种资源，或许她可以尝试收购一些秘境核心，毕竟并不是所有人都拥有探索秘境的能力的，有些秘境是真的危险。

之前爻雪进入的还只是2级秘境而已，就算是这样，她也不敢硬碰硬，但问题是，她现在还无法拿出能够与秘境核心等价的物资交换。

就在爻雪胡思乱想的时候，外面的三人已经走了进来。

进入商店之后，他们先是被里面的景象给震惊到了，食物，摆满了整整一货架的食物，那些幸存者说的竟然是真的。

从震惊中回过神来之后，他们这才注意到柜台后面的爻雪。

自从末世降临以来，水资源被污染，每个人都是脏兮兮的，突然看到如此干净的人出现在他们面前，三人的心中忽然升起了一抹自卑感。

尤其是被两个哥哥护着的女孩儿，看着爻雪那一头乌黑亮丽的头发，她不自觉地摸了摸自己的头发，为了方便，也为了避免自己被盯上，她亲手剪掉了自己的头发。

此时她的头发因为太短，再加上多日没有打理，如同狗啃的一般。

爻雪仿佛是没有注意到他们的狼狈一般，笑着说道：“欢迎光临游戏商店，几位可以先看看本店的规则。”

说着，她指了指旁边的墙壁。

爻雪不乐意一遍遍说着相同的话，虽然她是NPC没错，但她也是人啊，又不是机器人，索性直接将规则都写了出来，让来人自己看。

For some reason, looking at the building in front of them, they had an inexplicable feeling in their hearts, that is, as long as they passed by, they would be able to survive.

The moment this idea appeared, even they themselves found it ridiculous. After all, they should have felt a crisis when such a weird building appeared. Otherwise, why would those people prefer to group together and capture other communities instead of coming here? Is it because they are afraid that this is a trap, and they will be in trouble when they come.

At this time, Yaoxue still didn't know that this was the reason why she had so few guests in so many days. She was still thinking that when more and more guests awakened their powers, and other people knew about it, she would not have to worry about the number of guests, and the demand for rooms would probably exceed the supply by then.

In addition to the resources outside, the secret realm is also a kind of resource. Maybe she can try to acquire some secret realm cores. After all, not everyone has the ability to explore the secret realm, and some secret realms are really dangerous.

Yaoxue had only entered the level 2 secret realm before. Even so, she did not dare to confront him head-on. But the problem was that she was still unable to exchange materials that were equivalent to the core of the secret realm.

Just when Yaoxue was thinking wildly, the three people outside had walked in.

After entering the store, they were first shocked by the scene inside. There was a whole shelf full of food. What the survivors said was actually true.

After recovering from the shock, they noticed Yaoxue behind the counter.

Since the end of the world, water resources have been polluted and everyone is dirty. Suddenly seeing such a clean person appear in front of them, a sense of inferiority suddenly arises in the hearts of the three of them.

Especially the girl who was protected by her two brothers. Looking at Yaoxue's black and shiny hair, she touched her hair unconsciously. For convenience and to avoid being stared at, she cut off her hair with her own hands.

At this time, her hair was too short and had not been taken care of for many days, and it looked like a dog gnawing it.

As if she didn't notice their embarrassment, Yaoxue said with a smile: "Welcome to the game store. You can take a look at the rules of our store first."

As she spoke, she pointed to the wall next to her.

Yaoxue was not happy to say the same words over and over again. Although she was an NPC, she was also a human being and not a robot. So she simply wrote out the rules and let the visitors read them for themselves.
